marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind south 20 knots increasing to south 25 late this afternoon
then diminishing to south 15 late overnight. Wind diminishing to light late
Sunday morning. Scattered flurries ending overnight. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>
